title: Design System: ปฏิทินของฉัน (calendarforme)

display.purpose: The single giant day numeral on the pad.

day-numeral.purpose: Grid day numbers; outside-month days at 700 and 0.6x.

pad-line.purpose: Month-and-year (22px) and weekday (18px) on the pad.

label.purpose: Buttons, weekday row, month tabs, field labels, toast, links.

chip.purpose: One-line entry chips in day cells.

shadows.name: falling-sheet
shadows.purpose: Only on the wrapper of a page tearing off and falling. Nothing at rest casts a shadow.

motion.name: ease-paper
motion.purpose: Settling without bounce: page hover lift, tear button, buttons, dialog, toast, chip pop, sheet drop, month slide.

motion.name: tear-fall
motion.purpose: The torn sheet falls with gravity, swaying and rotating to 19deg.

motion.name: sheet-drop
motion.purpose: Going back: a sheet drops onto the pad from -104%.

motion.name: scrap-burst
motion.purpose: Red and ink paper scraps when a duty is ticked or a sheet rips.

motion.name: month-slide
motion.purpose: Month change slides in the direction of travel.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Fill changes on buttons, cells, tabs.

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Default sheet control: square ink outline that fills solid on hover.

components.name: Tear Button
components.description: Pad control on red paper: dashed white stroke, sinks and deepens on hover.

components.description: The months chooser in the strip under the grid; current month is solid ink.

components.name: Entry Chips
components.description: One-line entries in a day cell: red square for duties, green circle for activities.
components.html: จ่ายค่าเน็ตเที่ยวเขาใหญ่ส่งรายงาน
components.css: .ds-chips { display: grid; color: #14110f; } .ds-chip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font: 600 13.5px/21px 'Noto Sans Thai', 'Leelawadee UI', sans-serif; } .ds-mark { flex: none; width: 8px; height: 8px; display: block; } .ds-duty { background: #d0021b; } .ds-activity { background: #2e7d4f; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-done span { text-decoration: line-through; opacity: .7; }

components.name: Day Cells
components.description: Grid days on dashed rules: weekend red, past struck, today a solid red block.

narrative.northStar: The Tear-Off Pad (ปฏิทินฉีก)
narrative.overview:
The interface is the calendar object itself: a Thai-Chinese tear-off day pad, flooded in calendar red, bound by an ink strip, and joined to a full month sheet printed on thin off-white paper. Everything reads as print and paper: black-weight Thai serif numerals, plain Thai sans for everything small, dashed perforation lines ruling the sheet, square corners, flat ink.

Density is a printed wall calendar's: the month must be read at a glance, so numerals are large and black, entries are single-line chips under them, and the chrome is reduced to outline buttons and a slim month strip. Life comes from paper behaviour rather than decoration: the page lifts under the hand, rips along its perforation and falls with weight, scraps burst when a duty is ticked, months slide by.

It rejects the office calendar: no sidebar-plus-blue-chips arrangement, no rounded cards, no elevation. Light theme only, by decision.
keyCharacteristics: One flood of calendar red (the pad page, today), ink black, thin paper, almanac green as the third ink.
Black-weight (900) Thai serif numerals; Thai sans 400/600/700 for all small text.
Dashed perforation lines as the sheet's rules and the pad's tear edge.
Square corners everywhere; the only circle is the activity mark.
Flat at rest; one drop shadow, only under a sheet in motion.
Motion with paper weight: falls with gravity, settles without bounce.

rules.name: The One Flood Rule
rules.body: Calendar red floods exactly two things: the pad page and today's cell. Elsewhere it is ink-sized (weekend numerals, duty marks, ticks). Never introduce another red surface.

rules.name: The Shape-and-Ink Rule
rules.body: Duties are red squares, activities green circles. Kind is always carried by shape as well as colour; on the red pad both marks turn white and keep their shapes.

rules.name: The Serif Is for Numbers Rule
rules.body: The serif carries numerals and titles only, always at 900 (700 for receding numerals). Everything small is the sans at 600.

rules.name: The Paper in Motion Rule
rules.body: Nothing at rest casts a shadow. The only shadow in the world is under a sheet that is falling.

dos: Do keep calendar red as a flood only on the pad page and today's cell.
Do carry entry kind by shape and colour together: red square for duties, green circle for activities.
Do set every numeral and title in Noto Serif Thai 900 with lining numerals; set small text in Noto Sans Thai 600.
Do use dashed strokes for anything that is part of the paper (perforations, day rules, pad add controls) and 1.5px solid ink for controls on the sheet.
Do let motion behave like paper: fall with gravity, settle on cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), never bounce, and drop it under reduced motion.
donts: Don't round corners; the activity mark is the only circle.
Don't add shadows to anything at rest; the falling sheet's drop shadow is the only one.
Don't use the office-calendar arrangement of a sidebar with blue rounded event chips.
Don't add a dark theme; the world is light only, by decision.
